fit: I plan and write English and Arabic content for real-estate brands every week, and run the Address Scoop news page.
PR, media coordination and press materials
Lighter match. I write press-style news daily and fact-check every figure, but I have not run media relations for a corporate yet.
I coordinate creators, designers and media buyers on every campaign launch, with brand guidelines on every deliverable.
Management reports from GA4 and Looker Studio, and technical overview decks on site health for The Address Holding.
I brief and review the work of content creators, designers, media buyers and production houses every week.
As a property consultant and now a marketer, I present to owners and senior management, and I present on camera to an audience of hundreds of thousands.
Corporate, B2B and a comparable industry
Civil engineer on naval-base infrastructure, then three years with the developers whose compounds Elsewedy Utilities powers and maintains.
why: My first job was on a construction site. After civil engineering at Alexandria University I supervised roadworks and infrastructure at the 3rd of July naval base, where every decision ran through engineers, contractors and senior officers.

Then I moved to the customer side of the built environment. For three years I sold property in New Cairo and worked daily with developers, which is why the news of Elsewedy Utilities bringing power distribution to Zahra and Skyline made immediate sense to me.
Since 2023 I have worked in marketing communications: SEO and content, technical specifications for web teams, and now campaigns, events and on-camera video for The Address Investments.
